topic: Trophic Levels and Energy Flow in Ecosystems
key_concepts: A food chain shows the eating sequence and energy transfer among organisms.
A food web is a network of interconnected food chains and is more realistic than a single
The sun is the ultimate source of energy on Earth.
Producers such as plants convert solar energy into chemical energy in food.
Consumers obtain energy by feeding on other organisms.
Decomposers like bacteria break down bodies of dead organisms.
An energy pyramid arranges trophic levels from producers to tertiary consumers.
Energy is lost as heat as it moves through an ecosystem.
Predator-prey relationships are common in ecosystems.
Disruptions to one part of a food chain can affect the rest of the ecosystem.
Food availability can affect reproduction and population size of consumers.
Aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems both have energy pyramids with producers and consumers.
